units.text: INT. DRIVE-IN PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT
A cramped cinderblock room lit by the glow of the projector.
The reel clatters.
Below, through a small window, a sea of parked cars and a flickering screen.
TEO MARCHETTI, 16, skinny, in a paper hat from the snack bar, threads film with careful hands.
Behind him, LULA BRIGHTWATER, 16, braids and a denim jacket, sits on an upturned crate, swinging her feet.
You said your uncle wouldn't be here tonight.
units.name: LULA

units.text: He isn't. He's in Tulsa.
units.name: TEO

units.text: Then why are you sweating?
units.name: LULA

units.text: It's a hundred degrees in here.
units.name: TEO

units.text: HAMID ZAIDI, 17, Teo's best friend, slouches in the doorway with a bag of popcorn and a smirk.
He has not been invited.
Marchetti. Heard you were showing a double feature up here. Me and Lula.
units.name: HAMID

units.text: Nobody said that.
units.name: TEO

units.text: Lula said it. At the pool.
units.name: HAMID

units.text: Lula stops swinging her feet.
Teo looks at her.
She looks at the floor.
I said we might hang out. That's different.
units.name: LULA

units.text: It's the same thing, apparently.
units.name: HAMID

units.text: Hamid, go back downstairs.
units.name: TEO

units.text: You can't tell me what to do. You're a guy in a paper hat.
units.name: HAMID

units.text: Teo's jaw tightens.
He turns off the second projector and stands, gripping the reel in his fist like something he might throw.
Say it again.
units.name: TEO

units.text: Teo, don't.
units.name: LULA

units.text: MRS. ESTELLE VANTERPOOL, 60s, the theater owner, in a cardigan and orthopedic shoes, appears in the doorway behind Hamid.
She taps a flashlight against her palm.
Mr. Marchetti. Why is the screen showing a blank sheet?
units.name: MRS. VANTERPOOL

units.text: Teo drops the reel.
It rolls across the floor and stops at her feet.
It's my fault, Mrs. Vanterpool. All of it.
units.name: TEO

units.text: She picks it up, studies the three of them, and hands the reel back to Teo.
Then you can fix it. And your friends can buy their own popcorn.
units.name: MRS. VANTERPOOL
